<USER_QUERY>
which state is Trivandrum in?
</USER_QUERY>

WITH a AS
    (SELECT geometry
     FROM read_parquet('divisions_area')
     WHERE id = '320d54bd-f085-4fd5-8812-8c6509f7a61e')
SELECT b.id,
       b.names."primary" AS name,
       b.subtype,
       ST_AsGeoJSON(b.geometry) AS geometry
FROM read_parquet('divisions_area') AS b,
     a
WHERE b.subtype = 'region'
    AND ST_Contains(b.geometry, a.geometry)
